passive.name: Serpentine Grace
passive.description: All Move Speed bonuses are more effective on Cassiopeia.

primaryAbilities.name: Noxious Blast
primaryAbilities.description: Cassiopeia blasts an area with Poison after a brief delay, granting her increased Move Speed if she hits an enemy champion.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Cassiopeia blasts noxious gas, <keywordMajor>Poisoning</keywordMajor> enemies and dealing <magicDamage>{{ tooltiptotaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> over {{ poisonduration }} seconds. Hitting a champion grants Cassiopeia <speed>{{ champhitmsbonus }}% Move Speed</speed> decaying over {{ champhitmsduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Miasma
primaryAbilities.description: Cassiopeia releases several clouds of poison, slowing, grounding, and lightly damaging enemies that pass through them. Grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Cassiopeia spews venom, leaving toxic clouds for {{ cloudduration }} seconds. Enemies in the clouds take <magicDamage>{{ damagepersecond }} magic damage</magicDamage> per second, are <keywordMajor>Poisoned</keywordMajor>, <status>Grounded</status>, and <status>Slowed</status> by {{ slowpercent }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Twin Fang
primaryAbilities.description: Cassiopeia lets loose an attack that deals increased damage to Poisoned targets and heals her for a percentage of the damage dealt. If the target dies from this attack, Cassiopeia regains Mana.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Cassiopeia launches deadly fangs, dealing {{ basicdamage }} magic damage. If the enemy is Poisoned, they take an additional {{ bonuspoisoneddamage }} magic damage and Cassiopeia restores {{ healcalc }} Health, reduced to {{ healcalcminion }} Health against lane minions and small monsters.

If this kills the target, Cassiopeia restores {{ cost }} Mana.

{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Petrifying Gaze
primaryAbilities.description: Cassiopeia releases a swirl of magical energy from her eyes, stunning any enemies in front of her that are facing her and slowing any others with their back turned.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Cassiopeia unleashes a petrifying gaze, dealing <magicDamage>{{ rdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Stunning</status> enemies facing her for {{ rccduration }} seconds. Enemies facing away are <status>Slowed</status> by {{ rslowpercent }}% decaying over the same duration instead.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
